customManagers.description: Track Go for THIS REPO's line. One repo ships one line, so the cap keeps it on 1.27.x: the next minor arrives as a new repo, never as a bump here.

packageRules.description: The 127 line stays on 1.27.x. Not an automerge exception -- automerge is the family default (ship-if-green) and still applies; this only stops Renovate from walking the line onto a Go minor it was never built for.

The BOOTSTRAP Go (actions/setup-go) stays on this repo's line too. Go is self-hosting, so this is the compiler that builds the toolchain we ship -- an ingredient, not CI trivia. Left uncapped it automerged its way onto the next minor in a repo capped to its own line, silently changing a shipped artifact's inputs with a green build as the only signal, and putting the next line's version in a repo that must never build it. A new Go line is a new repo.
